# One classify run serves every engine test tier

## Context

#21541's AC-1, split out the way #21635 took its AC-2: one classify job per push serves both `test.yml` and `test-e2e.yml`. The plan is [issuecomment-7050487185](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21541#issuecomment-7050487185), and the author's go with two additions is [issuecomment-7050608623](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21541#issuecomment-7050608623).

## The Problem

Both test workflows call `classify-test-scope.yml`, so it runs twice per push. Each run takes one of the org's 20 runners at the push burst, where queue wait starts.

## The Architectural Reality

- A workflow cannot read another workflow's job outputs (`WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs:18-20`), so one classify run per push means one workflow.
- `test-e2e.yml` calls the classifier with `select_e2e: true`, and the selection then overrides the shared `skip_reason`.
- `classify-test-scope.yml:467` names `test-e2e.yml` in the e2e boundary, and `learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md:42` names the file.

## The Fix

1. Fold the e2e jobs into `test.yml` behind its `changes` job, with `select_e2e: true`, and delete `test-e2e.yml`.
2. Keep the e2e selection's reason in its own classifier output, so the components gate prints its own.
3. A dispatch names the e2e tier with `suite: e2e`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] One `Classify test scope` job per push, and every tier keeps its jobs, gate and check.
- [ ] A pull request editing `test.yml` runs the e2e tier.
- [ ] The components gate never prints the e2e selection's reason.
- [ ] The unit arms read the folded `test.yml`.

## Out of Scope

- AC-3's push-to-green receipts, which stay on #21541.
- The gates that start a runner for a ruled-out tier.
